summary: Belize's Immigration Department lets travellers check by nationality whether they need a visa, and exempts from the entry visa, for visits not exceeding 30 days, holders of a valid multiple-entry visa or permanent residence card from the United States or Canada and holders of a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa. It says a stay longer than 30 days needs a Visitor's Permit Extension from an Immigration Office, which allows an additional 30 days for BZD 200. The UK, US, Canadian and Australian governments tell their citizens they need no visa for visits of up to 30 days.

tips.text: Belize's Immigration Department exempts from the entry visa, for visits not exceeding 30 days, holders of a valid multiple-entry visa or permanent residence card from the United States or Canada, and holders of a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa.

The UK Foreign Office says that if you leave Belize by land, or by water crossing to Guatemala or Mexico, you must pay a departure tax of 40 Belize dollars or 20 US dollars at the border, and that if you leave by air the tax is usually included in the ticket price.

Belize's Immigration Department says a stay longer than 30 days needs a Visitor's Permit Extension from an Immigration Office, which allows an additional 30 days; the fee is BZD 200 for all nationals.
The Government of Canada advises against non-essential travel to Southside Belize City, south of the Haulover Creek River, because of gang and drug-related violence, including murders and shootings.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Belize?
faq.answer: Belize's Immigration Department lets you check by nationality whether you need a visa. If you need one and live outside Belize, you can apply at your nearest Belizean diplomatic or consular mission; holders of a valid multiple-entry visa or permanent residence card from the United States or Canada, or of a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa, are exempt from the entry visa for visits not exceeding 30 days. The UK, US, Canadian and Australian governments tell their citizens they need no visa for visits of up to 30 days.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Belize?
faq.answer: Belize's Immigration Department says that if you will stay longer than 30 days you need to visit an Immigration Office to extend your stay with a Visitor's Permit Extension, which allows an additional 30 days; the fee is BZD 200 for all nationals.

faq.question: Can I enter Belize with a US visa instead of a Belizean visa?
faq.answer: Yes. Belize's Immigration Department exempts from the entry visa, for visits not exceeding 30 days, holders of a valid multiple-entry visa or permanent residence card from the United States. A valid multiple-entry Schengen visa, or a valid multiple-entry visa or permanent residence card from Canada, qualifies too.

faq.question: Is travel insurance mandatory for Belize?
faq.answer: No official source we could read requires it. The Government Press Office's Cabinet brief of 14 July 2022 says Cabinet approved the removal of all public health measures at points of entry.

faq.question: Can I pay with US dollars in Belize?
faq.answer: The Government of Canada says US dollars are widely accepted, that prices are sometimes provided in US dollars, and that change for payments in US dollars is frequently given in Belize dollars.

levies.name: Departure tax (international airport)
levies.exemptions: Visits to Belize of less than 24 hours; persons under 12; crew of the departing aircraft.
levies.text: Every person leaving Belize at an international airport pays a departure tax of 20 dollars; the Act does not name the currency. People whose visit lasts less than 24 hours, persons under 12 and crew of the departing aircraft do not pay it. Each airline collects the tax from its own passengers. The UK government says that when leaving by air the tax is usually included in the airfare.
